description: This file contains the implementation of the OrderService class, which handles creating orders from shopping baskets, interacting with repositories and specifications to retrieve and process data related to orders, baskets, and catalog items.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Implements order creation logic, interacting with repositories to fetch basket and catalog data, and creating new order records.

methods.name: CreateOrderAsync
methods.description: Creates a new order from the specified basket ID and shipping address, performing data retrieval and transformation to generate order items and save the order.
